title: WARD Chain Descriptor
description: A ward chain descriptor (v0.2). Summarizes chain metadata for management purposes. See SPEC.md section 7.

chain_id.description: Unique chain identifier, e.g. "ward:org/quox/env/production" MUST NOT contain the reserved "::" sequence.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with UTC Z suffix — when the chain was created

entry_count.description: Total number of entries in the chain

head_seq.description: Sequence number of the latest entry (0 if chain is empty)

head_chain_hash.description: chain_hash of the latest entry, or genesis_hash if chain is empty
